author: paigejasmine
body:
Okay I wanna start off by saying that I do know that Avicus is a PVP server, and I dont want creative to take out the whole idea of the server but this is just a recommendation.

I think Avicus should have a creative mode!
I think having creative would bring in a lot more players. And if people want to build things with their friends from the server, they can do it while still being on Avicus. 

Honestly I dont know what else to say but let me know if you agree, and put some ideas if you think this is a good idea, because I don't even know if it is. 

:)))
